threads.body:
With `latest` on 3.x, the full suite no longer runs on any 2.x - `v2` is pinned to 2.8.0 and only covers the legacy interactions path. Could we either:

1. rename `requirements.v2.txt` to `requirements.v2.8.txt` (keeping the legacy interactions run), and add a new `requirements.v2.txt` with `google-genai==2.34.0` that runs the full suite, or
2. drop the 2.8-specific env and run the full suite on `v2` with the latest 2.x (2.34.0)?
threads.hunk:
@@ -37,7 +37,7 @@
 # This variant of the requirements aims to test the system using
 # the newest supported version of external dependencies.
 
-google-genai==2.34.0
+google-genai==3.0.0

replies.body: 3.0.0 only changed the default HTTP transport (httpx2) and API version (v1), so 3.0.0 already exercises the exact same >= 2.9 SDK code paths as 2.34.0, while 2.8.0 is needed to cover the < 2.9 _interactions branch... So I'll take approach 1 here..
